answer: Each epoch, identities earn influence only by publishing timestamped forecasts of near-future observable events — prices, weather, match results — scored later by Brier accuracy. The knoll of the scheme is independent judgment: a controller running a thousand puppets must either copy one forecast across them, leaving a detectable comet-tail of correlation, or fund a thousand genuine research efforts — as costly as a thousand real analysts. Puppet predictions correlate and fail; honest agents build calibrated records, each true signal clear as crystal.
